title: Full Moon in Cancer
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Cancer / Capricorn axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates protection, emotional honesty, home, belonging, and the private life that supports the public one through the Cancer side of the axis, while the Sun in Capricorn asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: caretaking as avoidance of your own needs, or protecting yourself until connection cannot reach you
integration: creating safety that does not become isolation

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc reveals where success was chosen over softness.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Cancer / Capricorn balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Luna kamea, silver or white candle, lavender, water, and incense.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Cancer can be embodied without rejecting Capricorn.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Cancer, and what balance with Capricorn is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Cancer Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
